content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TISS Senior Research Associate Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 20-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TISS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TISS Senior Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the TISS Senior Research Associate position is 20th September 2026. Ensure you apply well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Senior Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in any field of Social Sciences with at least 55% aggregate marks, along with a Ph.D. in any field of Social Sciences.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Research Associate post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 75,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Research Associate position as per the released notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the TISS Senior Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1000/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 250/- for SC/ST candidates. Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications, followed by a virtual interview, and finally, document verification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age limit for the Senior Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Specific age limits are not detailed in the provided summary. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any age-related criteria.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the TISS Senior Research Associate recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Senior Research Associate is offered on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article, where a direct link will be provided.
